title: feat(objectql): refuse a nested-relation condition and a lookup dimension up front on a driver without the readableIdsLeaf capability
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9H1aMNiqTkNWDWgxMXym6yC)_

Fixes #33876

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #33875 — skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md (its nested-relation row still promises the capped id read on every driver; MongoDB and OData now refuse it)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：spec 新增驱动能力位 `DriverCapabilities.readableIdsLeaf`(SQL 各方言、Turso、内存驱动声明，MongoDB/OData 不声明)。引擎在单值关系的嵌套条件(读操作)上看这个位：没有它就在规划/读取任何关联数据之前直接拒收 `INVALID_FILTER`/400,点名驱动并给出两步写法；分析里「经查找字段分组的维度」用同一个位，没有它就 `INVALID_QUERY`/400。
- 为什么改：执行你在 #33626 Q2 选的 A(评论 6889543194):不会跑跨对象 where 的驱动在引擎里提前给稳定 400。另外落实 #33876 上 6917475155 的范围说明，维度那半边用同一个能力位一次判定。
- 风险与回滚：只影响 MongoDB、OData 和不声明该位的第三方驱动上的部署：这类条件过去走「先读关联 id、上限 1000」的回退，现在改为 400(收窄)。多值关系和 update/delete 的 where 不变。回滚＝回退本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine-query-lowering.ts`(where 提前拒收)、`packages/objectql/src/relation-group-join.ts`(维度拒收与新的 refused 结果)、`packages/spec/src/data/driver.zod.ts`(新能力位)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-nested-relation-lowering.test.ts`,预期 31/31 绿，其中「a driver without the readableIdsLeaf bit … is refused up front」一条覆盖 Mongo/OData/未声明驱动在四个读操作上都是 400 且一次读取都没有。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 让 ADR-0139 D3 的「不再引入 DriverCapabilities 位」一句失效，ADR 修订归席位另立的 skills 卡；本 PR 应在那张修订落地后再合。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `DriverCapabilities.readableIdsLeaf` (optional boolean, absence = `false`): the driver's filter compiler compiles (or, in process, evaluates) a composed `ReadableIds` leaf. TSDoc and the live-bit list in the schema header say who reads it. The driver reference pages are regenerated.
- **Drivers**: `driver-sql` declares it on every dialect (`SqliteWasmDriver` and `TursoDriver` inherit it; Turso's remote transport compiles the leaf with its own compiler). `driver-memory` declares it (it evaluates the leaf in process, ruling Q1, comment 6889549817). `driver-mongodb` and `driver-odata` are unchanged and do not declare it.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`, the where half** (`engine-query-lowering.ts#lowerRelationConditions`): on `find` / `findOne` / `count` / `aggregate`, every relation site is judged before any related read is planned or run. If any single-valued site exists and the read's driver lacks the bit, the read is refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 (`relation-filter-lowering.ts#relationSemiJoinDriverRefusal`), naming the driver and the two-step route. `relation-semi-join.ts` drops the hard-coded `SEMI_JOIN_COMPILING_DRIVERS` name set; `relationSemiJoinServes` and the refusal both read the bit through `driverCompilesReadableIdsLeaf`. A multi-valued relation and the `where` of `update` / `delete` keep the capped id read on every driver.
- **`@objectstack/objectql`, the dimension half** (`relation-group-join.ts#relationGroupDriverRefusal`, called first in `engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts#aggregate`): a relation group request on a driver without the bit gets a new outcome `{ kind: 'refused', error }` (`INVALID_QUERY` / 400) and nothing is read. A driver with the bit that compiles no join (memory, Turso) is declined as before.
- **`@objectstack/service-analytics`**: the plugin's engine bridge returns the engine's refusal as `refusal` on a `joined: false` answer, and `ObjectQLStrategy#executeCrossObjectJoined` throws it instead of falling back to the FK-expand. A host that wires no `executeRelationGroupAggregate` keeps the FK-expand (it never asks the engine).
- **Docs**: `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx` and `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` listed "a driver that compiles no subquery (MongoDB, OData)" as an id-read fallback case. This change makes that false, so both pages now say the condition is refused there.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-nested-relation-lowering.test.ts`: the recording driver now declares `supports` (default: the bit). The old pin "a driver that compiles no subquery (MongoDB, OData, any unnamed driver) keeps the capped id read" is replaced by the refusal pin: MongoDB, OData, an undeclared name and a SQL name each with `{}`, `{ readableIdsLeaf: false }` and `{ readableIdsLeaf: 'true' }` give `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 on all four read verbs and under `$or` / `$not`. The message names the driver, the driver sees no read, and a multi-valued relation and an `update` `where` keep the id read. A control: a driver named MongoDB that declares the bit plans the semi-join (the bit decides, not the name).
- `packages/objectql/src/relation-group-join.test.ts`: memory and Turso (bit, no join) stay declined. MongoDB, OData and a SQL name without the bit are refused, `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 on the outcome, and the driver is never called.
- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/cross-object-relation-group-join.test.ts`: on a real `SqliteWasmDriver` re-declared as MongoDB without the bit, a `stage` dimension query answers `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 naming the driver, outcome `refused`, and zero driver reads (no FK-expand). A control re-declared as Turso with the bit is declined and served by the FK-expand, with the same rows as the reference.
- `packages/spec/src/data/driver.test.ts`: the live-bit roster is six; absence parses to no key; a non-boolean is refused.
- `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.test.ts`: `supports` is `{ readableIdsLeaf: true }`. `packages/drivers/driver-mongodb/src/mongodb-readable-ids-conformance.test.ts`: MongoDB does not declare the bit.

Tests changed because the behaviour changed (each named): in `credential-evaluation-guard.test.ts`, `query-expression-conformance.test.ts` and `engine-readable-ids-nested-composition.test.ts` the test drivers stand for drivers that run the nested condition, so each now declares the bit. Their assertions are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-measured on `origin/main` e8cba8fe: the card body says MongoDB/OData reach the driver and answer `INTERNAL_ERROR` / 500. PR #33652 as merged (9a7f8c1c) keeps the capped id read for a driver outside the name set instead. So this change turns a served read (up to 1,000 related matches) into a 400 on those drivers: a narrowing. The claim's `Clause-②: yes` is copied as written; whether it takes the `(narrowing)` arm is an open question for the seat.
- The dimension refusal uses `INVALID_QUERY`, not `INVALID_FILTER`: a dimension is not a filter, and `INVALID_QUERY` is the code the engine already uses for a group-key refusal. The scope note asks for "the same stable 400". The status is the same; the code is the seat's call.
- The where refusal sits ahead of the related object's own doors on those drivers. A caller with no read access to the related object now gets the 400, not a 403, on MongoDB/OData.
- The claim reads `Metadata-protocol: none`. The changeset gate refuses `none` here because the authorable-surface shard `packages/spec/authorable-surface/data.json` gains `data/DriverCapabilities:readableIdsLeaf`, so this PR declares `added` (spec `minor`) and carries the `Skills-docs:` line.
- ADR-0139 D3 says "No `DriverCapabilities` bit returns". This PR adds one with its reader in the same change, as the ruling orders. The ADR amendment is a governed surface outside this card's file surface, so it is reported as owed for the seat's `domain:skills` card.

## Verification

Readings are in the os-dev-report on #33876.
